title: Open the workbench without exposing sign-in tokens
when: Opening a local or self-host workbench
need: Run yoke ui up from your own terminal on a machine with a display. Admission goes directly to the browser. Text, JSON and status omit the link and token; agent mode, disabled opening and browser failures name the reason and recovery. Source review commands use the same private opener; automated review supplies a fixture token explicitly and keeps it out of output.
surface: UI command help and feedback; workbench sign-in guide.
review: Source and command regression coverage; deployment proof remains separate.
